Head-and-shoulders, hands out of frame. Shot on Sony A7 IV, FE 85mm f/1.8, f/2.8, 1/200s, ISO 100. Keep the face exactly as in the reference photo: the same facial features, face shape and skin, nothing altered and no added makeup; real skin texture. She is the only person in the frame. There are no signs, posters, brand logos or lettering anywhere in the frame; no props other than what is described; modest clothing.
